_comments: Template for ~/.claude/settings.local.json. Loaded AFTER settings.json and
merges into (does not replace) the permissions allowlist.
Format: 'Bash(<command>)' for exact match, 'Bash(<prefix>:*)' for prefix match.
Example: 'Bash(git status)' matches only 'git status'; 'Bash(git:*)' matches
any git invocation. Quote paths with spaces and escape backslashes in regex.
The allowlist below is minimal -- safe read-only commands plus the tools the
repo's skills actually invoke (latexmk, pdftoppm for /tikz-iterate; python and
node for general use). Add project-specific entries as you go; Claude Code will
prompt on first use and offer to remember.
_personalized_examples shows how to structure project-scoped entries with your
own paths. Copy entries you want into the 'allow' array and replace the
<OVERLEAF_ROOT> / <PROJECT_SUBDIR> placeholders. We deliberately do NOT ship
Lan's full allowlist because it pins his Dropbox/Overleaf project paths.
